story: One day, Emperor Akbar asked who the greatest fool in the kingdom was. Birbal brought a man riding a donkey while carrying a load on his head. When asked, the man said he did not want to burden the donkey. Birbal explained that the donkey was still carrying both him and the load. Akbar understood that foolish thinking causes unnecessary trouble.
